name: Cleave
description: On a hit with a melee Cleave weapon, you can make a single weapon attack against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. Damage doesn't add your ability modifier unless that modifier is negative.

name: Graze
description: If your attack roll misses with a Graze weapon, you can deal damage equal to your ability modifier to the target.

name: Nick
description: When you make the bonus attack from the Light property with a Nick weapon, you can make that attack as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action.

name: Push
description: On a hit with a Push weapon, you can push the target up to 10 feet straight away from you if it's Large or smaller.

name: Sap
description: On a hit with a Sap weapon, the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Slow
description: On a hit with a Slow weapon, the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Topple
description: On a hit with a Topple weapon, the target makes a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your weapon ability modifier). On a failure, the target has the Prone condition.

name: Vex
description: On a hit with a Vex weapon, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against the same target before the end of your next turn.
